jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Senior AI Software Engineer

**Role Summary** We are seeking a Senior AI Software Engineer to drive the design, architecture, and production delivery of modern AI\-driven platforms. In this role, you will apply senior\-level software engineering discipline to bridge the gap between cutting\-edge AI research and scalable enterprise systems. The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering experience—with a proven track record of shipping production software—with hands\-on expertise in generative AI, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and multi\-agent architectures.

* **W\-2 Only:** Direct W\-2 applicants only *(No C2C / No Subcontracting / No 1099\).*
* **No Sponsorship:** Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production AI Architecture:** Architect, build, and ship scalable, production\-grade software applications that integrate machine learning models, Large Language Models (LLMs), and complex AI workflows.
* **Multi\-Agent Systems \& Agentic Workflows:** Design and implement multi\-agent orchestration systems (e.g., CrewAI, AutoGen, LangGraph) capable of autonomous task execution, tool use, memory management, and multi\-step reasoning.
* **Full Lifecycle Product Delivery:** Own end\-to\-end features from concept through deployment, monitoring, and maintenance, ensuring high availability, sub\-second latencies, and security compliance.
* **RAG \& Knowledge Retrieval:** Build and optimize production RAG pipelines utilizing hybrid search, reranking, vector databases, and custom data connectors to maximize retrieval accuracy and eliminate hallucinations.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.  

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well\-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.  

  

**Job Title:** API Solutions Architect  

**Location:** 100% Remote (U.S.)  

**Position Type:** Full\-time, Direct W2  

**Salary Range:** $100,000–$150,000 Annually  

**Experience Required:** 6\+ years  

  

**Sponsorship:** U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H\-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H\-1B visa petitions for this position.
